subject: Recap & Next Steps: Redwood MAP for Acme - discovery call 11/12

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Recap & Next Steps: Redwood MAP for Acme - discovery call 11/12

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for a productive conversation today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Pain points you shared
- Intermittent latency spikes on user-facing search (99th percentile often > 750ms) causing poor UX.
- Inference spend has grown ~3x in last 6 months; procurement is focused on unit economics.
- Data residency / audit requirements: need SOC 2 evidence and ability to run in VPC/on-prem for part of workload.

Goals you defined
- Reduce per-query cost by ~30–40% while keeping quality parity.
- Bring 99th%-ile latency under 300ms for the primary search flow.
- Run a 6-week pilot targeting 500k queries/day aiming for Jan 2027 pilot start and production by end of Q1 2027.

Key stakeholders mentioned
- Jordan Miller (Search Product Lead) — primary sponsor
- Michael Chen (CTO) — technical sign-off
- Lisa Nguyen (Procurement) — contract/po

Proposed next steps
1) I’ll send a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones, owners, and dates (attached).
2) Schedule a technical deep-dive with Michael & the infra team (30–45m) — proposed week of Nov 22.
3) Share an estimate for pilot pricing + SLA options by Nov 18.

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v1.pdf (draft MAP), SLA-summary.pdf

If anything above is inaccurate or missing, please reply with edits. Otherwise I’ll slot the tech deep-dive and update the MAP with any additional owners.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan (draft) — Redwood MAP for Acme (milestones, owners, dates)

Hi Jordan / Michael / Lisa —

Following up with the draft Mutual Action Plan based on our discovery. I’ve attached the detailed PDF (Redwood-MAP-v1.pdf). Below is the high-level MAP so it’s easy to consume in-thread: 

Mutual Action Plan — high level
- Pilot scope: inference for search ranking on primary traffic (approx 500k q/d), 6 weeks.
  Owner: Acme (Jordan) / Redwood (Marissa)
  Target start: 2027-01-10
  Success criteria: 40% cost reduction vs current baseline; 99th-pct latency < 300ms; no regression in top-k relevance (A/B test).

- Technical deep-dive & benchmarking
  Owner: Acme (Michael) / Redwood (R&D + Solutions)
  Target date: week of 2026-11-22 (propose Nov 23 @ 11am PT)
  Deliverables: latency histograms, model variant recommendations, KV caching plan, pilot infra sizing.

- Procurement & contracting
  Owner: Acme (Lisa) / Redwood (Legal & Sales Ops)
  Target date: initial PO conversation by 2026-12-15; contract signed by 2026-12-31 (if on accelerated path).
  Notes: include options for Dedicated vs Private deployment and an SLA addendum (summarized in attached SLA-summary.pdf).

- Pilot execution & monitoring
  Owner: Acme (Eng) / Redwood (Customer Success)
  Target date: 2027-01-10 to 2027-02-21
  Deliverables: daily ingestion/health dashboard, weekly QA checks, final pilot report with cost/latency deltas.

Risks & open items
- Procurement timeline could push pilot start — we’ll provide a commercial uplift schedule if timeline slips.
- Data residency: if Acme requires on-prem for pilot, that will extend setup by ~2 weeks (need confirm).

Requested next steps (action owners)
- Jordan: confirm pilot scope & stakeholders in-thread (reply by Nov 18).
- Michael: confirm Nov 23 deep-dive availability (or propose alternate).
- Lisa: confirm procurement milestone expectations and whether a draft PO can be initiated by Dec 15.
- Neha/Marissa (Redwood): provide pilot pricing estimate & tech agenda by Nov 18 (attached).

I’ll update the attached MAP with any edits and send a calendar invite for the Nov 23 technical deep-dive once dates are confirmed.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v1.pdf, SLA-summary.pdf
